description: Auto-PR flow: non-major updates open weekly grouped PRs; low-risk lanes automerge on green CI; majors are gated on the dashboard.

packageRules.description: Batch every non-major update into one weekly review PR.
Majors carry breaking changes: gate them on the dashboard and soak longer so a human opts in per package.
GitHub Actions are SHA-pinned and run cheap CI.
Docker base-image version bumps ship into published images — group them for review.
Automerge non-major GitHub Actions once CI is green — SHA-pinned, cheap to verify, high-toil to hand-merge.
Automerge digest-only re-pins (same tag, new SHA) across managers — no version change to review.
Move the Playwright npm packages and the CI container image together: the visual job runs @playwright/test inside mcr.microsoft.com/playwright, which ships only the browsers of its own version.
Hold the server's `canvas` alias below 1.0.12: 1.0.12 makes ctx.canvas a read-only getter (Brooooooklyn/canvas#1373), and jsdom's getContext() assigns it, so every jsdom canvas throws.

Hold pdfmake below 0.3.12: its browser build (used by the server PDF worker with the VFS fonts) bundles pdfkit 0.20, which rejects VFS font file names for SVG <text>, so every PDF export throws. Still broken in 0.3.13.
Keep the verified React Flow/system pair until the touch regression is fixed.
Keep the system version required by the verified React Flow version.
Keep Node PDF export working until the ESM package entry is fixed.
Match the VS Code API series declared in engines.vscode.
Keep TypeScript within typescript-eslint's supported peer range.
Move formatter-minor migrations into a separate formatting change.
@types/pdfmake — pinned to 0.2.x because 0.3.x removed the .vfs property used by standalone/server/src/workers/pdf-conversion-worker-thread.ts. Re-evaluate when migrating the worker to the 0.3 API.
